outcome: Recurrence rate of cesarean uterine scar pregnancy (CSP)
Time to get out of bed
cohort: 142 patients diagnosed with cesarean uterine scar pregnancy.
finding: Treatment of cesarean uterine scar pregnancy with UAE combined with MTX resulted in better therapeutic outcomes, including higher effective rates, lower recurrence and complication rates, faster recovery times, and improved hormonal profiles compared to MTX treatment alone.
